newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunkers up on earlier crude gains.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunkers up on earlier crude gains.

text.p: Singapore bunker indications on Tuesday were quoted higher in line with the jump seen in crude prices on Friday, traders said.

They said the hike in Brent crude futures prices on Friday has fuelled the rise in Rotterdam 380-cst prices from $113 to $118-$120 per tonne. But although a relapse in crude on Monday may have erased its earlier gains, bunker prices have held.

This has triggered the rise in prices in Asia. Majors were quoting 180-cst prices at $126-$128 and 380-cst at $121-$123. Independents were quoting $1-2 lower. MDO and gas oil prices were at $215-$220 and $230-$235 respectively.
